Agent Name: Verification_Expert  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Verification_Expert made the first mistake by failing to critically evaluate the discrepancies in the data provided by the four sources (Zillow, Redfin, Trulia, and Realtor.com). Instead of investigating why Realtor.com reported a significantly higher sale price ($5,200,000) compared to the other sources, the agent prematurely concluded that the highest sale price was $5,200,000 based solely on this single data point. This violates the manager's directive to ensure accuracy and reliability, as the data from Realtor.com should have been cross-verified further to confirm its validity. The lack of deeper scrutiny and verification of the outlier data led to a potential error in solving the real-world problem.
